profile.subtitleJa: ギデオンが麦を打った町
profile.summaryJa: 士師記6:11では、主の使いがオフラにある樫の木の下に座る。その木はアビエゼル人ヨアシュのものとされ、ギデオンはミディアン人から隠れて麦を打っていた。

facts.textJa: ギデオンはオフラに祭壇を築き、「主は平和」と名づける。
ギデオンはエフォドを作って自分の町オフラに置いた。
ギデオンはオフラのアビエゼル人の墓に葬られた。
アビメレクはオフラの父の家でギデオンの息子たちを殺した。

profile.modernLocationJa: マナセ族アビエゼル人の町とされるが、現代所在地は特定できない。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 主の使いが樫の木の下でギデオンに現れた町として初出する。
profile.locationNoteJa: 記事は複数のオフラの用例と伝承を扱います。ギデオンの町の正確な現代位置は未確定で、候補点は参考表示です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The LORD’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.
Then Gideon built an altar there to the LORD, and called it “The LORD is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.
Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.
